# Guangxi Province Travel Guide

> An independent, firsthand travel guide to Guangxi, China — karst peaks, a volcanic island, a Vietnam-border waterfall, rice terraces and luosifen.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.guangxi-province.com/): The complete single-page guide covering destinations, itineraries, budget, food, weather, culture, safety and a traveler-type matcher.
- [About](https://www.guangxi-province.com/about/): Who we are and how we write.

## Core facts

- Guangxi is China's only region that is simultaneously coastal, border-facing and karst-covered.
- Eight core destinations: Guilin, Yangshuo, Longji Rice Terraces, Beihai & Weizhou Island, Chongzuo & Detian Waterfall, Liuzhou, Huangyao Ancient Town, and Bama & Hechi.
- Best overall window: October to April. Detian Waterfall peaks June to October. Longji terraces mirror April to June and turn gold September to October.
- A 5-day trip covers the essentials; 7 days adds the coast-border-karst loop.
- Visa-free entry for citizens of 76 countries, plus a 240-hour transit visa-free policy for 55 countries (via Guilin and Nanning).
- Signature food: luosifen (snail rice noodles, born in Liuzhou), Guilin rice noodles, beer fish, laoyoufen, lemon duck.

## Content principles

- Written from firsthand travel across all 14 prefectures.
- No sponsored listings, no booking commissions.
- Prices are 2026 averages, reviewed quarterly.
